# Localization reference

The language table asset, the resolver every display string passes through, and the text for failure reasons. For how to use it, see [Localization](../modules/localization.md).

## VtLocalizationTable

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Localization → Localization Table**.

One language: a list of key and text pairs. Create one per language, fill it from your sheet, and install it with `VtLocalization.SetTable`. Keys are the strings authored on definitions, so an untranslated key shows as itself.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Language (`language`) | `string` | `"en"` | Language code, for example 'en' or 'de-DE'. Informational. |
| Entries (`entries`) | [VtLocalizationEntry](#vtlocalizationentry)[] | Empty | Key and translated text, one row per string. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool TryGet(string key, out string text)` | Look up `key`. False when the table has no row for it or the row is empty. |
| `void Rebuild()` | Rebuild the lookup after editing `entries` at runtime. |

## VtLocalizationEntry

Serializable class.

One translated string.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Key (`key`) | `string` | Empty | The string as authored on the definition, for example 'item.sword.name' or the English text. |
| Text (`text`) | `string` | Empty | What to show in this language. |

## VtLocalization

Static class.

Turns an authored display string into the text to show. Every `displayName`, `description`, dialogue line and answer in the package passes through `Resolve` before it reaches the screen, and your UI should do the same for anything it reads off a definition.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtLocalizationTable Table { get; }` | The table answering lookups, or null. |
| `static string Language { get; }` | Language code of the current table, or empty. |
| `static Func<string, string> Resolver { get; set; }` | Custom lookup that takes precedence over the table. Return null to fall through to the table and then to the raw string. |
| `static event Action OnLanguageChanged` | Fires after the table or resolver changed. Redraw text here. |
| `static void SetTable(VtLocalizationTable newTable)` | Install `newTable` as the current language. Null clears it. |
| `static string Resolve(string keyOrText)` | The text to show for `keyOrText`: the resolver's answer, else the table's, else the built-in default, else the string itself. |
| `static void RegisterDefaults(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> entries)` | Register built-in text for keys, used when neither the resolver nor the table has a key. Registering a key again replaces its text. The package registers its own keys at load; a module of your own can register the English of its keys the same way. |
| `static bool TryGetDefault(string key, out string text)` | The built-in text registered for `key`, if any. |
| `static string Format(string keyOrText, params object[] args)` | `Resolve` followed by `string.Format` with `args`, for lines with numbers in them. |

## VtFailureText

Static class.

The text to show a player when a gameplay call refuses. Every failure reason in the package has a localization key and a built-in English line, so a toast or a tooltip is one call to `Describe`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `const string KeyPrefix` | Prefix every failure-reason key starts with. |
| `static string Key(VtAbilityCastFailReason reason)` | Localization key for an ability cast failure. |
| `static string Key(VtCraftFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a crafting failure. |
| `static string Key(VtEquipFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for an equip failure. |
| `static string Key(VtProgressionFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a talent or attribute point failure. |
| `static string Key(VtBuildFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a building failure. |
| `static string Key(VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a vendor failure. |
| `static string Key(VtResourceNodeFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a refused hit on a resource node. |
| `static string Key(VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a party failure. |
| `static string Key(VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a chat failure. |
| `static string Key(VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a guild failure. |
| `static string Key(VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a friend list failure. |
| `static string Key(VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a mail failure. |
| `static string Key(VtUnlockFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for an unlock failure. |
| `static string Key(VtInventoryFailureReason reason)` | Localization key for a refused inventory slot operation. |
| `static string Describe(VtInventoryFailureReason reason)` | Text for a refused inventory slot operation; empty for `VtInventoryFailureReason.None` and for `VtInventoryFailureReason.AuthorityNotLocal`, which means the request was sent to the authority, so a view can show the result of every slot call without toasting on clients. |
| `static string Describe(VtInventoryRefusal refusal)` | Text for a refused inventory slot operation: the refusing slot rule's key resolved through `VtLocalization` when it has one, else the text of its reason. |
| `static string Describe(VtAbilityCastFailReason reason)` | Text for an ability cast failure; empty for `VtAbilityCastFailReason.Success`. |
| `static string Describe(VtCraftFailureReason reason)` | Text for a crafting failure; empty for `VtCraftFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtEquipFailureReason reason)` | Text for an equip failure; empty for `VtEquipFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtProgressionFailureReason reason)` | Text for a talent or attribute point failure; empty for `VtProgressionFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtBuildFailureReason reason)` | Text for a building failure; empty for `VtBuildFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtBuildRefusal refusal)` | Text for a refused placement: the refusing rule's key resolved through `VtLocalization` when it has one, else the text of its reason. Empty when nothing refused. |
| `static string Describe(VtVendorFailureReason reason)` | Text for a vendor failure; empty for `VtVendorFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtResourceNodeFailureReason reason)` | Text for a refused hit on a resource node; empty for `VtResourceNodeFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtPartyFailureReason reason)` | Text for a party failure; empty for `VtPartyFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Text for a chat failure; empty for `VtChatFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Text for a guild failure; empty for `VtGuildFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtFriendsFailureReason reason)` | Text for a friend list failure; empty for `VtFriendsFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Text for a mail failure; empty for `VtMailFailureReason.None`. |
| `static string Describe(VtUnlockFailureReason reason)` | Text for an unlock failure; empty for `VtUnlockFailureReason.None`. |
| `static bool TryGetEnglish(string key, out string text)` | The built-in English line for `key`. False when the key is not a failure-reason key. |

## Enums

### VtAbilityCastFailReason

Result of `VtUnitAbilities.TryCast`. `Success` means the cast started (instant abilities resolve the same frame; casts with non-zero `castTime` begin their cast bar). All other values are soft failures — callers can surface them to UI as feedback ("not enough mana", "out of range", …) without exceptions.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Success` | Cast accepted. Either resolved this frame (instant) or cast bar started. |
| `NotGranted` | Ability is not in the caster's granted list. |
| `InvalidTarget` | Target does not match the ability's `VtTargetingMode` (e.g. single-target ability cast with no target). |
| `OutOfRange` | Target is out of the ability's `range`. |
| `NotEnoughResource` | Caster's resource pool cannot cover the ability's `resourceCost`. |
| `OnCooldown` | Per-ability cooldown is still ticking. |
| `OnGCD` | Global cooldown is active and this ability does not ignore it. |
| `AlreadyCasting` | Caster is mid-cast of another ability (and the queue is full / disabled). |
| `Incapacitated` | Caster's traits forbid casting right now (silenced / stunned / CanCast=false). |
| `CasterDead` | Caster is dead. |

### VtCraftFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitCrafter.IsAvailable` check or `VtUnitCrafter.TryCraft` call refused. Surfaced via the `out` param on those calls and the `VtUnitCrafter.OnCraftFailed` event so consumer UI can render a precise "you can't craft this because…" message.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The check passed — recipe is craftable / craft succeeded. |
| `RecipeNull` | The recipe argument was null. |
| `NotLearned` | The crafter doesn't know this recipe yet (not `learnedByDefault` + not in the unit's `VtUnitRecipeBook`). |
| `MissingIngredients` | The unit's inventory doesn't hold enough of one or more `VtRecipeDefinition.inputs` ingredients. |
| `MissingRequiredItems` | The unit's inventory doesn't hold one or more `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredItems` tools (must-have but not consumed — e.g. Crafter's Tools). |
| `WrongStation` | The recipe requires a station the player isn't using (null station or wrong type). |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's `VtUnitLevel.Level` is below `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredLevel`. |
| `SkillTooLow` | The unit's `VtUnitCraftingSkills.GetLevel` for the recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredSkill` is below `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredSkillLevel`. |
| `MissingPrereqQuests` | One or more `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredCompletedQuests` haven't been turned in yet. |
| `AlreadyCrafting` | A timed craft is already active. Cancel it first or wait for it to complete. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Replica side refused the mutation; only authority can craft. |
| `NoCrafterComponent` | The unit doesn't carry a `VtUnitCrafter` component. Returned by external helpers; the crafter itself never emits this since it can only be invoked when present. |
| `TooFarFromStation` | The crafter is farther from the station than its interact radius allows. |
| `Locked` | The recipe's `VtRecipeDefinition.requiredUnlock` is not owned. |
| `InventoryFull` | The output would go into the crafter's bag and the bag has no room for it, even after the ingredients are taken out. |

### VtEquipFailureReason

Why an attempted `VtUnitEquipment.TryEquip` / `VtUnitEquipment.CanEquip` call refused the operation. Returned via the `out` parameter so callers (UI tooltips, AI, item-pickup handlers) can surface a precise reason without guesswork.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The operation succeeded — the request would equip cleanly. |
| `NullItem` | The supplied item was null. |
| `SlotMismatch` | The slot the caller asked for doesn't match the item's authored slot (and isn't in the same family for ring / trinket items). |
| `LevelTooLow` | The wearer's level is below the item's `VtItemRequirements.levelMin`. |
| `AttributeTooLow` | The wearer's resolved attribute totals don't satisfy one of `VtItemRequirements.attributeMins`. |
| `MissingRequiredTag` | The wearer doesn't have `VtItemRequirements.requiredUnitTag`. |
| `SlotOccupiedBlocked` | A slot conflict that cannot be auto-resolved — typically equipping into `VtEquipmentSlot.OffHand` while a two-handed weapon occupies `VtEquipmentSlot.MainHand`. Caller must unequip the conflicting slot first. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | The caller is not the authoritative owner of this unit. In multiplayer modes `VtUnitEquipment.TryEquip` rejects on replicas; the authoritative side mutates and the net layer mirrors via `VtUnitEquipment.ApplyEquippedFromNet`. |
| `NotInInventory` | `VtUnitEquipment.TryEquipFromInventory` was asked for an item the unit's bag does not hold. |
| `InventoryFull` | The unit's bag has no room for the item taken off. |
| `WouldOverflowInventory` | The item adds to the bag's capacity, and without it the bag could no longer hold what it holds. Empty the bag first. |
| `TargetSlotRefused` | The bag slot named to take the item holds something that cannot be worn there, is shut, or its rules refuse the item. |
| `HeldSlotFull` | A `VtUnitHeldSlot` holds the main hand and its area has no free slot for the item. |

### VtProgressionFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitProgression.CanLearn`, `VtUnitProgression.TryLearn` or `VtUnitProgression.TrySpendAttributePoint` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Nothing refused; the call succeeded. |
| `NoTree` | The unit has no talent tree. |
| `NotInTree` | The talent is not part of the unit's tree, or is null. |
| `MaxRank` | Every rank is already learned. |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's level is below the talent's requirement. |
| `MissingPrerequisite` | A prerequisite talent is missing or below the required rank. |
| `NoPoints` | Not enough unspent points. |
| `AttributeNotAllowed` | The tree does not allow points in that attribute, or the attribute is null. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtBuildFailureReason

Why a builder call was refused or a placement is invalid.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Nothing refused: the call succeeded or the placement is valid. |
| `BuildableNull` | No buildable was given, or it has no prefab. |
| `MissingItems` | The builder cannot pay the buildable's item cost. |
| `MissingCurrency` | The builder cannot pay the buildable's currency cost. |
| `MissingRequiredItems` | The builder does not carry the buildable's required items, such as a hammer. |
| `LevelTooLow` | The builder's level is below the buildable's required level. |
| `MissingPrereqQuests` | A quest the buildable requires has not been turned in. |
| `BlockedByCollider` | A collider on the buildable's forbidden overlap layers is in the way. |
| `NoSurface` | The cursor points at no surface the piece can stand on. |
| `AlreadyPlacing` | A placement is already in progress. |
| `NotPlacing` | Nothing is being placed. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | This copy is not the authority. `VtUnitBuilder.TryPlace` and `VtUnitBuilder.TryDemolish` send the request to the authority, which decides. |
| `NoBuilderComponent` | The unit has no builder component. |
| `NotABuildable` | The target of a demolish is not something this system placed. |
| `CrossesCliff` | The footprint spans more than one cliff level or lies on a ramp. |
| `OutOfRange` | The placement point is farther from the builder than the buildable's placement range. |
| `Locked` | The buildable's `VtBuildableDefinition.requiredUnlock` is not owned. |
| `BlockedGround` | The footprint covers a cell the cliff map marks as blocked. |
| `RefusedByRule` | A placement rule refused. `VtBuildRefusal.RuleKey` carries the rule's own reason. |

### VtVendorFailureReason

Why a `VtVendor.CanBuy`, `VtVendor.CanSell`, `VtVendor.TryBuy` or `VtVendor.TrySell` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The trade can go ahead. |
| `VendorNull` | The vendor component has no definition. |
| `ItemNull` | No item, or a count of zero. |
| `NotSold` | The vendor does not carry this item. |
| `OutOfStock` | The vendor holds fewer than asked. |
| `NoPrice` | The item has no value currency and no price override. |
| `NoWallet` | The customer has no wallet. |
| `CannotAfford` | The customer cannot pay. |
| `NoInventory` | The customer has no inventory. |
| `InventoryFull` | The purchase would not fit in the customer's inventory. |
| `NotSellable` | The item is not sellable, or the customer holds fewer than offered. |
| `VendorDoesNotBuy` | This vendor does not buy from players. |
| `TooFar` | The customer is farther from the vendor than its interact radius allows. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtResourceNodeFailureReason

Why a hit on a `VtResourceNode` was rejected (damage cancelled before it landed). Surfaced via `VtResourceNode.OnHarvestFailed` so the consumer's UI can render precise feedback like "Need an axe!" or "Mining 50 required."

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The hit was accepted — the node took damage and harvested. |
| `Depleted` | The node is currently depleted (already chopped) and is waiting for its respawn timer to elapse. |
| `WrongTool` | The attacker doesn't have an item with the required tool tag equipped (e.g. no axe in any equipment slot when chopping a tree). |
| `SkillTooLow` | The attacker's level in the required `VtCraftingSkillDefinition` is below the node's threshold. |
| `WrongDamageType` | The damage type (`VtDamageType`) isn't in the node's `VtResourceNodeDefinition.acceptedDamageTypes` list. E.g. ore takes Blunt only — a Slash sword bounces off. |
| `InventoryFull` | The attacker's inventory has no room for even one of anything the node yields, so the hit is refused and the node keeps its HP. |

### VtPartyFailureReason

Why a `VtUnitParty` call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `InvalidTarget` | No target, the unit itself, a unit without a party component, a hostile unit, or someone not in this party. |
| `TargetInParty` | The invited unit already belongs to a party. |
| `AlreadyInParty` | This unit already belongs to a party. |
| `NotInParty` | This unit belongs to no party. |
| `NotLeader` | Only the leader may do this. |
| `PartyFull` | The party has `VtTuning.partyMaxSize` members. |
| `NoInvite` | No invite is pending, or the inviter is gone. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtChatFailureReason

Why a chat send refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The message was sent. |
| `EmptyText` | Nothing left after trimming and stripping markup. |
| `TooLong` | Longer than `VtTuning.chatMaxLength`. |
| `RateLimited` | Sent faster than the chat limit allows. |
| `Muted` | The sender is muted. |
| `Filtered` | The filter rejected the text. |
| `NoRecipient` | The whisper target is not online, or is the sender. |
| `NotInParty` | Party chat without a party. |
| `NotInGuild` | Guild chat without a guild. |
| `ChannelNotAllowed` | Players cannot send on System or Npc. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the message was forwarded. |

### VtGuildFailureReason

Why a guild call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `AlreadyInGuild` | The player already belongs to a guild. |
| `NotInGuild` | The player belongs to no guild. |
| `NameInvalid` | The name is too short, too long, or has characters other than letters, digits and single spaces. |
| `NameTaken` | Another guild has this name. |
| `TagInvalid` | The tag is not 2 to 5 letters or digits. |
| `CannotAfford` | The founder cannot pay the creation cost. |
| `NoPermission` | The player's rank lacks the permission. |
| `TargetNotFound` | No online player by that name or id. |
| `TargetInGuild` | The invited player already belongs to a guild. |
| `TargetNotMember` | The player acted on is not a member of this guild. |
| `GuildFull` | The guild has `VtTuning.guildMaxMembers` members. |
| `NoInvite` | No invite is pending, or it expired. |
| `RankTooLow` | The target's rank is not below the acting member's. |
| `LeaderCannotLeave` | The leader must hand over leadership before leaving a guild with other members. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtFriendsFailureReason

Why a friends call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `PlayerNotFound` | No known player by that name or id. |
| `CannotBefriendSelf` | A player cannot befriend itself. |
| `AlreadyFriends` | Already friends. |
| `RequestPending` | A request to that player is already waiting. |
| `FriendListFull` | The player has `VtTuning.friendsMaxCount` friends. |
| `TargetFull` | The other player's friend list or request inbox is full. |
| `NoRequest` | No such pending request. |
| `NotFriends` | The players are not friends. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtMailFailureReason

Why a mail call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `RecipientNotFound` | No known player by that name or id. |
| `CannotMailSelf` | A player cannot mail itself. |
| `RecipientMailboxFull` | The recipient has `VtTuning.mailboxMaxCount` mails. |
| `SubjectEmpty` | The subject is empty after cleaning. |
| `TooLong` | The subject or body is longer than allowed. |
| `TooManyAttachments` | More attachment lines than `VtTuning.mailMaxAttachments`. |
| `UnknownDefinition` | An attached item or currency id is not in the Definition Catalog. |
| `NoInventory` | The sender has no inventory for item attachments. |
| `MissingItems` | The sender holds fewer items than attached. |
| `ItemNotTradeable` | An attached item cannot be traded. |
| `NoWallet` | The sender has no wallet for currency or postage. |
| `CannotAfford` | The sender cannot pay the attached currency plus postage. |
| `MailNotFound` | No mail with that id in the mailbox. |
| `AttachmentsRemaining` | Take the attachments before deleting. |
| `InventoryFull` | Some attached items did not fit; the rest stay attached. |
| `NotReturnable` | System mail and returned mail cannot be returned. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtUnlockFailureReason

Why `VtUnitUnlocks.TryUnlock` was refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | Nothing went wrong. |
| `UnlockNull` | No unlock was given. |
| `AlreadyUnlocked` | It is already owned. |
| `MissingPrerequisite` | One of its required unlocks is not owned yet. |
| `LevelTooLow` | The unit's level is below the unlock's required level. |
| `MissingItems` | The cost source lacks the items. |
| `MissingCurrency` | The cost source lacks the currency. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | This process is not the authority; the request was forwarded. |

### VtInventoryFailureReason

Why a slot operation on a `VtUnitInventory` was refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | It worked. |
| `NoSuchSlot` | The area or slot does not exist on this inventory. |
| `SlotEmpty` | The slot to take from is empty. |
| `AreaShut` | The area is shut, for example because the backpack that opens it is not worn. |
| `RefusedByRule` | A slot rule refused the item. `VtInventoryRefusal.RuleKey` says why. |
| `NotEnough` | More was asked for than the stack holds. |
| `CannotSwap` | Part of a stack cannot be swapped with a different item; move all of it or pick an empty slot. |
| `TargetFull` | The stack in the target slot is full. |
| `NoRoom` | No other slot has room. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | The caller is not the authority for this unit; the request was sent to it. Not a refusal: `VtFailureText.Describe` returns no text for it. |
| `EquipRefused` | Putting an item on or taking it off was refused. `VtInventoryRefusal.EquipReason` says why. |
| `CarryLimit` | The target area already holds as many items as its unit limit allows. |
| `NotDroppable` | The item cannot be dropped: it is bound, or no world item prefab is set for it. |
